name: Eleven Finance
fix_description: In emergencyBurn, add _burn(msg.sender, balan) before the token.safeTransfer call to destroy the user shares. Without burning shares, the user can call emergencyBurn repeatedly to drain the vault since balanceOf(msg.sender) never decreases.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a flash loan, token swaps, adding/removing liquidity, vault deposit/withdraw interactions, and abusing a protocol-specific emergencyBurn flow. While the PoC is not very long, understanding why the vault accounting breaks requires reading Eleven Finance’s vault logic rather than spotting a simple generic bug.
